units.source_text: 中将看见源氏公子吟时愁容满面，哀思不浅，

en.t: The Middle Captain saw that Prince Genji's face was full of sorrow as he recited his poem, and that his grief was deep.

units.source_text: 窃自想道：“原来我看错了：

en.t: He thought privately to himself, "So I was mistaken after all:

units.source_text: 我以为源氏公子这几年来对阿妹并无何等深恩重爱，

en.t: I had thought that in these past few years Prince Genji had not felt any especially deep affection or attachment for my sister,

units.source_text: 只因桐壶爷屡次训诫他，父亲也一片苦心地疼爱他，

en.t: and that it was only because His Majesty Kiritsubo repeatedly admonished him, and because Father cherished him with such painstaking care,

units.source_text: 加之他和母亲乃姑侄之谊，有此种种关系，

en.t: and also because he and Mother were bound by the relationship of aunt and nephew, along with all these other ties,

units.source_text: 所以他不便抛弃，勉强敷衍，实乃一大遗憾。

en.t: that he could not very well abandon her and was merely forcing himself to keep up appearances, which would truly have been a great pity.

units.source_text: 岂知我这看法全是误解，

en.t: But now I see that this view of mine was entirely mistaken,

units.source_text: 原来他对这正夫人是非常疼爱又重视的！”

en.t: and that he truly loved and valued his lawful wife very deeply!"

units.source_text: 他恍然大悟之后，便觉葵姬之死越发可惜，

en.t: After this sudden realization, he felt Lady Aoi's death was all the more regrettable,

units.source_text: 仿佛家里失去了光彩，何等不幸！

en.t: as though the household had lost its very radiance. What a misfortune it was!
